title: Patch a finite normal family
statement: For a finite family of finite intermediate subalgebras contained in the integral closure, with a supremum having integrally closed prime localizations, there is a finite intermediate algebra contained in the integral closure with all prime localizations integrally closed.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0333, finite-family compactness and finite-supremum paragraphs

proof.text: Use the supplied supremum S as the witness B. Rewrite by hS. Finset.sup_le and the containment component of hs show S is contained in the integral closure.

Prove finiteness of the supremum by induction on the finite family. The empty supremum is the bottom subalgebra, finite by Mathlib Subalgebra.finite_bot (Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.Subalgebra, line 30). For an insertion, install the finiteness hypothesis for the new algebra and the induction hypothesis for the remaining supremum as local instances; rewrite Finset.sup_insert and apply Mathlib Subalgebra.finite_sup (Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Finite, lines 152-156).
The hypothesis hn is precisely the required integrally closedness of all prime localizations of this witness S. Combine it with containment and finiteness to obtain the existential conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0333, final finite-supremum paragraph; Lean proof uses Mathlib finite_sup induction, with localization normality supplied by hn

from.place: decomposition of finite-family extraction and supremum patching

lean.statement:
theorem finite_normal_sup (A : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (s : Finset (Subalgebra A K)) (S : Subalgebra A K)
    (hS : S = s.sup (fun C : Subalgebra A K => C))
    (hs : ∀ C ∈ s, C ≤ integralClosure A K ∧ Module.Finite A C)
    (hn : ∀ (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime],
      IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)) :
    ∃ B : Subalgebra A K, B ≤ integralClosure A K ∧ Module.Finite A B ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime], IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)
